requirements.title: ACCESS= value is SEQUENTIAL, DIRECT, or STREAM
requirements.definition: The ACCESS= scalar default character expression shall evaluate to SEQUENTIAL, DIRECT, or STREAM.

requirements.title: Existing file ACCESS= method must be allowed for the file
requirements.definition: For an existing file, the specified access method shall be included in the set of allowed access methods for the file.
